'''Football Club Kramatorsk''' ({{Langx|uk|Футбольний клуб Краматорськ|label=[[Ukrainian language|Ukrainian]]}}; {{Langx|ru|Футбольный клуб Краматорск|label=[[Russian language|Russian]]}}) is a professional [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] football club from the city of [[Kramatorsk]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]].

The club takes its history from a factory team of the Old Kramatorsk Machine-building Plant (SKMZ)."}}
